A '''RSEP-1 Thermal Shield''' was a type of [[Thermal shield/Legends|thermal shield]] in use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] used one in conjunction with a [[Ramjet/Legends|ramjet]] while fighting the crew of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']].
